title: Austin's Urban Progress and Fines
summary:
*   **Infrastructure Expansion:** Approved significant street paving projects for Guadalupe, Whitis, and 24th Avenues, and established permanent grades for several city streets to guide future development.
*   **Civic Development & Professional Growth:** Authorized the Fire Chief and City Engineer to attend national conventions, with one approved despite noted budget concerns. Began preliminary survey work for a new municipal park and wharf.
*   **Commercial & Social Regulation:** Reconsidered a permit for a new petroleum filling station on Congress Avenue and approved an electric sign for a downtown cigar store. Conditionally remitted a fine for public drunkenness, emphasizing rehabilitation.
*   **Revenue Collection:** Authorized the Superintendent of Streets to hire a contractor to collect overdue sewage rental payments to improve city finances.

Fine / Drunkeness
remitted
.The Mayor laid before the council the following resolution :

Whereas, the City Council believes that in the particular case here numbered the
defendant, B Haigler, has been punished enough and that to suspend his sentence may have a
good moral effect upon him,
Now, therefore,
Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That the balance of the fine and
costs ,amounting to $ 31.80, in cause No 8868, State of Texas vs B Haigler,drunkeness, in
the Corporation Court of the City of Austin, Texas, be and the same is hereby suspended
and agreed by the City Council to be wholly remitted -provided, the said B Haigler shall
not be re-arrested for drunness at any time within three months from the date of the
passage of this resolution .
Total fine and costs ,$ 59.80,worked out $ 28.00, balance owing ,$ 31.80.

The resolusion was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony,Bartholomew,Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.

Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Bucks Cigar
Store Sign

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution: Whereas, the petition of Bucks
Cigar store near the intersection of 8th street and Congress Avenue in this City for the
installation of an electric light sign in front of its place of business is recommended by
W L Eyres, Sign Inspector,

Now, therefore,
Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That a permit to install said
electric light sign at Bucks Cigar store near the intersection of 8th street and Congress
Avenue is hereby granted to the said Bucks Cigar store, with the following provisos:

1. That when the sign is suspended it must meet with the approval of
Walter L Eyres, Sign Inspector.
2. That this permit is subject to revocation at any time in the pleasure of the City
Council.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.

Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

The Council then adjourned.
